## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "It is difficult to test model variance when using custom unstructured text datasets..."

## Describe the proposed solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Tell us what new AI models, prompting structures, or data pipelines we should add.

## Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered or tried out locally.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, code blocks, screenshots, or layout mockups about the feature request here.
